text: DSH System Prompt 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的提示词插件：为本地配置的模型按 provider/model 路由追加自定义系统提示词。它在 DSH 的系统提示词组装中注册动态内容，并提供 Settings 页面管理规则。主要功能包括为单个模型设置规则、为整个 provider 设置通配规则，以及将两类匹配规则按顺序合并；保存后下一次模型请求即可生效，规则会保存在本机并在重启后恢复。适合希望按模型定制工作规范或输出要求的 DSH 用户。使用前无需额外 API Key 或外部账号。

DSH System Prompt is a prompt plugin for the DSH web client: it appends custom system prompt text to locally configured models by provider/model route. It registers dynamic content in DSH system prompt assembly and provides a Settings page for managing rules. Users can set a rule for one model or a provider-wide wildcard; matching rules are combined in order and saved changes apply to the next model request. Rules are stored locally and restored after restart. It suits DSH users who want different working instructions or output requirements for different models. No additional API key or external account is required.
我想给不同模型配置不同的系统提示词。
能不能给一个模型供应商下的所有模型统一追加规则？
I want separate system prompt instructions for each configured model.
DSH System Prompt 的功能「按模型追加规则」：在 Settings 页面为 provider 下的单个模型或全部模型填写提示词规则。每次请求按实际 provider/model 路由匹配并追加到系统提示词；保存后下一次请求生效，空白规则可删除。
